summary: Lunar Frontier is an immersive, first person perspective simulation, that launches players into the boots of an astronaut on a high-stakes lunar mission. Experience a full day of lunar survival: maintain life support, manage critical base operations and conduct scientific breakthroughs. Lunar Frontier transforms the meticulous details of space exploration into a gripping educational adventure that reveals what it truly takes to be an astronaut.
details:
Lunar Frontier is an immersive, first person perspective simulation that launches players into the boots of an astronaut on a high-stakes lunar mission. Players awaken in the lunar base with a set of mini-missions to accomplish, simultaneously managing their life support and assessing risks. Mirroring real space missions, the tasks follow strict sequences with tangible consequences and an element of unpredictability, challenging the player to act swiftly and decisively.

Designed to be authentic and engrossing, Lunar Frontier features intuitive mechanics that younger players can grasp, paired with layered, critical challenges that keep teens and adults engaged. It aims to inspire awe in the players, revealing space exploration and protocols in unprecedented detail.

By researching multiple extraterrestrial missions for the mechanics of the game, the factors that an astronaut has to weigh in order to live in a lunar habitat are translated into practical gameplay, though it retains the grit of real missions.

Tools Used :

3D Graphics Engine: Three.js

Frontend UI & Styling: React 19, Tailwind CSS, Zustand

Coding Languages : TypeScript, JavaScript (ES Modules / Node.js), HTML5 & CSS3, GLSL / Shader Concepts

Developer Tools & Build Pipeline : Vite 7, Node.js

Deployment : Static hosting on Hugging Face Spaces

SI for modelling and coding assistance : Claude AI, Gemini AI
